title: phlox austromontana subsp. lutescens
intro: Phlox austromontana subsp. lutescens, commonly known as Golden Phlox, is a flowering plant species native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Golden Phlox are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Further research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and safety of using Golden Phlox as a medicinal herb.
